RENT AGREEMENT
This rent agreement is made at Bengaluru between Sample Owner C (the Owner) and Sample Tenant C (the Tenant).
1. Term
The tenancy is for a term of 11 months from the start date.
2. Rent
The Tenant shall pay monthly rent of Rs. 60,000 by bank transfer by the fifth of each month.
3. Deposit
The Tenant shall pay a security deposit of Rs. 1,20,000, equivalent to two months' rent, refundable within 30 days of vacating.
4. Lock-in
The Tenant shall not vacate the premises before the expiry of nine (9) months. If the Tenant leaves during the lock-in period, the Owner shall forfeit the deposit.
5. Notice
The Tenant shall give two months' written notice before vacating. The Owner shall give one month's notice to the Tenant.
6. Rent Revision
The Owner may revise the rent at his sole discretion from time to time.
7. Maintenance
Society maintenance charges shall be paid by the Owner.
8. Entry
The Owner may visit the flat after giving 24 hours notice.
9. Disputes
Disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of courts at Bengaluru.
